svg.title: flume: one launch, one place, a fresh agent for each stage
svg.desc: Three callers stand at the head of the flume: your session’s /launch, millpond’s send and headwater’s fix key. millpond sends item 7 as a change: the launch names the repository ledger, the kind change, the name csv-export, the base main and the brief, export the ledger as CSV. It runs down the flume into its place, a worktree at ledger/places/change--csv-export on the branch change/csv-export, cut from main, which flume makes ready by the repository’s declaration. Four stages light in turn, each with a fresh agent in a herdr pane whose prompt flume confirms in the agent’s transcript: construct ends when the OpenSpec change is written, code when all five of its tasks are ticked, and verify when its report exists. submit’s agent archives the change and submits the branch to main; sluice tests main with the change as merged and lands it, which ends the stage. flume then tidies the place: the worktree is removed, and the branch with it, since it holds nothing main lacks.
svg.text: one launch, one place, a fresh agent for each stage
its fix key on a release

g.text: made ready by the repository’s declaration
a herdr pane, for each stage’s agent
committed the export and its test
checked the code against the change
